answer: A newcomer files a juniper summons with the river panel: a court summons, its case number and signature checked against the mirror registry within forty-five minutes of the nonce. The river panel matches the summons, the case number, and the signature. A summons reused under a second name fails, and the person is barred for a cycle, forfeiting fifty units. An honest newcomer pays fifty units once; a thousand fakes pay fifty thousand units. A farm reusing one summons for a thousand clones fails: one summons binds one person to one juniper.
